fusions.name: Warning Spritz
fusions.desc: Spits a stinking jet that deals 7 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Weakened] for 5 seconds, draining its Power. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Rank Cloud
fusions.desc: Lets off a stench, dealing 24 poison damage to every enemy within 4 tiles, ignoring resistances, and leaving them [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 6 seconds. You restore 12 health.

fusions.name: Musk Coat
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Hard to Stomach
fusions.desc: When a non-fire blow hurts you, you regain 4 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
